name: study-guide-tutor-skill
description: Turns study material (slides, lecture notes, PDFs, textbooks) into a source-checked tutoring course: learner intake, fact ledger, one lesson per chapter with pictures, tricky-part hints and traps, audited exam-style quizzes, grading with memory anchors, flashcards, exams and spaced revisits. Includes 8 quality gates and two agents.
